query:
SELECT h.number AS "unit_number!", h.title AS "unit_title!", h.state AS "unit_state!", t.slug AS "track_slug!", a.sequence AS "attempt_sequence?", d.action AS "action!", d.reason AS "reason!", d.decided_at AS "decided_at!: _", d.origin AS "origin!" FROM decisions d
            JOIN review_cases c ON c.id = d.review_case_id
            JOIN units h ON h.id = c.unit_id
            JOIN tracks t ON t.id = h.track_id
            LEFT JOIN attempts a ON a.id = c.attempt_id
            WHERE c.project_id = $1 AND c.kind = 'decision'
              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM decisions s WHERE s.supersedes = d.id)
            ORDER BY d.decided_at DESC, d.id DESC
            LIMIT $2
